posts.title: Is the AI bubble bursting? What two earlier crashes can tell us
posts.summary: AI has crashed twice before, each time because promises outran proof. Using a credit card as the model, here is how both crashes happened, what is different now, and three questions to ask of any AI headline.

posts.title: Build your own AI agent harness from scratch in Python
posts.summary: A coding agent is a model plus a harness: the loop, tools, prompt, safety checks and memory around it. Here is one built from scratch in six small steps, with the code that matters at each layer.

posts.title: AI evals explained: how to test your AI app
posts.summary: A benchmark score tells you what to try, not what to ship. Here are the five ways AI gets graded, how to grade a search app and an agent, and the routine that turns it into a one-page eval plan for your own app.
